approach: Root cause: docs/decisions.md is prose and nothing links a decision to the code or limit it governs, so a change that reverses a decision (D08, job 20261010-225741-yvk0) or a stated limit (drain help "at most 8", job 20261105-180339-w5h7) is found only at the final verdict. Fix in three parts. (1) A small new athena-data module `decision_links` defines the `[[governs]]` table (decision id plus paths: an exact file, or a directory prefix ending `/`) and one pure function `unreconciled(base_links, cand_links, base_log, cand_log, changed_paths)`. It returns each governed decision whose paths the change touches, unless the candidate adds a `[[link]]` with `older = <id>` whose newer heading is new in the candidate's decisions.md. docs/decision-links.toml must already list every Amends/Supersedes phrase (backtest condition (a)), so a new link is the machine-readable form of "amended by / superseded by". decisions.md is append-only (pinned hash test), so a new entry plus a link is the only way to reconcile. The base's list judges. (2) `Athena::check_and_verify` (run/mod.rs) calls the new `Athena::unreconciled_decisions` (run/checks.rs) first, before the CI push, the early pull request, the checks and the verifier. On a hit the job closes failed with a reason naming each decision id, its governed paths and the fix; the retry brief carries it to the producer. A resume at the verifier stage, a nested run and a base with no list skip it. (3) `ConfirmedLinks` (athena-cli decisions.rs) reads and validates `[[governs]]` through the same athena-data parser; backtest.rs reports a governed id absent from the log as a condition (a) finding. D08 is mapped to crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs and crates/athena-core/src/run/candidate.rs. For the limit class, the drain help text becomes a template with a `{ceiling}` placeholder, filled from `athena_data::config::MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING` by `drain_after_help(ceiling)` and attached in a new `cli_command()` that `main` uses. Revision: tests for the real files now sit inline in decisions.rs and backtest.rs (no new tests/backtest.rs); criterion 6 now names its seam and what fails without the work.

decisions.choice: The reconcile signal is a new `[[link]]` in docs/decision-links.toml (older = governed id, newer = a heading new in the candidate's decisions.md), not a scan of the prose for 'Amended by'.
decisions.reason: The prose parse (`parse_supersessions`) lives in athena-cli, which athena-core cannot import. The links list is already forced to agree with the prose by backtest condition (a) and the `hits.len() == links.len()` test, so a new link cannot exist without the prose phrase. The check stays a pure comparison of two toml texts and two heading lists.

steps: Create crates/athena-data/src/decision_links.rs and register it in athena-data lib.rs. Define `Governs` (serde Deserialize/Serialize, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug); `parse_governs(text) -> Result<Vec<Governs>, String>` (id shape `D` plus 2 or more digits, non-empty paths, no leading `/` or `..`); `link_pairs(text) -> Result<BTreeSet<(String,String)>, String>` reading only `older` and `newer` of each `[[link]]`; `Governs::covers(path)` (exact, or directory prefix when the entry ends `/`); and `unreconciled(base_links, cand_links, base_log, cand_log, changed) -> Result<Vec<Unreconciled>, String>`. A decision is reconciled when the candidate has a pair (id, N) the base lacks, where `## N ` starts a line in the candidate log and in no line of the base log. The base's `[[governs]]` judges; a candidate list that does not parse counts as no new links. Add inline unit tests for D08, D12 and D02: not touched, touched without a link, touched with a link, a link for another id, a link whose heading is not new, a directory prefix versus a sibling path, a deleted path, a malformed list.

In crates/athena-cli/src/decisions.rs add `#[serde(default, rename = "governs")] pub governs: Vec<Governs>` to `ConfirmedLinks`; have `parse` validate it through `athena_data::decision_links::parse_governs` and turn its error into `anyhow`; add `unknown_governed(&self, entries: &[String]) -> Vec<&Governs>`; update the module doc; add inline tests named `governs_*`, a real-list test (loads docs/decision-links.toml, D08 maps to crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs) and `the_root_cause_is_named_in_the_changelog_and_the_log`.

In crates/athena-cli/src/backtest.rs add `check_governs(parsed, confirmed, findings)` pushing a `Finding { condition: "a", .. }` for each unknown governs id; call it in `run_on_from` after `check_parse` (line 307 region); add a unit test with a governs id of D9999.

Edit docs/decision-links.toml: describe `[[governs]]` in the header (fields, the reconcile rule, that the base list judges) and add D08 with `crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs` and `crates/athena-core/src/run/candidate.rs`.

In crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs move the drain `after_help` string into `const DRAIN_AFTER_HELP: &str` with `at most {ceiling}` in place of `at most 8` (the rest byte-for-byte the same); remove the attribute; add `fn drain_after_help(ceiling: u32) -> String` and `fn cli_command() -> clap::Command` (`Cli::command().mut_subcommand("drain", |d| d.after_help(drain_after_help(athena_data::config::MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING)))`); use `cli_command()` in `main` and in the existing `help_of` test helper; add the `drain_help_*` tests. Check the constant's type and cast to u32 only if needed.

In crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs add `Athena::unreconciled_decisions` (`pub(super)`): read docs/decision-links.toml and docs/decisions.md at `base` and `candidate` with `self.git.show_file` (None is the empty text); return None at once when the base links text is empty; on `Err` from the base list print a `warning:` line through `ctx.ui` and return None; otherwise return `Some(reason)`. The reason reads: the change touches code that a decision governs: for each, `Dnn (path, ...)`; add a decisions.md entry that amends or supersedes it, with a matching `[[link]]` in docs/decision-links.toml. It must hold none of the words `is_environment_reason` reads.

In crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs, at the top of `check_and_verify` before `push_ci_branch`, when `recorded_checks.is_none() && self.nested.is_none()`, collect the candidate's changed paths from `closing.candidate`, call `unreconciled_decisions`, and on Some(reason) set `closing.happened = self.failure(ctx, &reason)` with `changed_paths` kept, then return `Ok(closing)`. Add to run/tests.rs `produce_and_verify_order_tests`: `governed_edit_closes_before_the_verifier_starts`, `governed_edit_with_an_amending_entry_and_link_reaches_the_verifier`, `governed_check_is_skipped_for_a_resume_at_the_verifier`, `ungoverned_edit_reaches_the_verifier`; each repo commits docs/decision-links.toml and docs/decisions.md with `commit_file`, and the wrapper script sets the producer's edits and counts verifier calls.

Add the CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Added entry naming the root cause (same sentence), the check, the failure reason, the derived help text and what is left out (other prose copies of the ceiling).
Run `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; then `cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus`.

demonstrations.command: cargo test -p athena-core run::tests::produce_and_verify_order_tests::ungoverned && cargo test -p athena-data decision_links && cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus
demonstrations.observes: Production entry points: `Athena::go` and `unreconciled`. A job whose producer edits README.md in a repo whose list governs only another path closes on the normal path (verifier invoked). Pure tests show that deletes and renames of a governed path are refused, while a sibling path and a prefix of a directory are not. No reading rule changes, so the replay of accepted readings stays at 0 newly refused readings, under the 5% line; the refusal corpus run shows the reading gate is untouched. The extra refusals are only changes to governed paths, as the criterion intends.
demonstrations.fails_without: A check that refused every change, or matched by substring, would close the ungoverned job Failed, and the prefix-sibling pure test would fail.
